text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was talking with Narita Brian about today's training...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Understood.
Then today will be running the perimeter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Staaaaare...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What are you doing?
Hurry up, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready for the run.
Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...A good wind is blowing.
My blood is boiling—I feel like I could run forever.
Become—... wind... blood—run...
C-Crap...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
…………Tch.
Guess I really can't just ignore this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You rat, come out already.
I know you're hiding in the bushes.
Y-YES, SIR!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: 'Sup, Brian-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Just what are you trying to do?
Following me around since early this morning.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Er... H-Hmph... So you've figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? That's quite an attitude."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...Oh? You too, then."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's not it, I tell you! This is... a-an homage, okay?!
I'm showing respect!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I fail to follow your meaning.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be just like you, Brian-senpai!
A powerful, super cool Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been following Senpai around since morning,
studying her gestures and tone of voice!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: They want to be like me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You think copying my surface makes you my equal?
...Don't make me laugh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you want to step into the same ring,
come at me ready to tear flesh from bone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y—... Yes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Man, I really look up to that.
That unshakable, straightforward confidence.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll reach Senpai's level too—
...No, I'm going to surpass you!"
choice_data_list: That conviction will surely become your strength.
Want to test our strength running side by side?
Want to test our strength running side by side?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll reach Senpai's level too—
...No, I'm going to surpass you!"
choice_data_list: That conviction will surely become your strength.
Want to test our strength running side by side?
Want to test our strength running side by side?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? Does that mean I'm officially
one step closer to being a cool Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Can't just sit on my hands!
I've gotta get to training too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Not just matching me, but surpassing me, huh.
You've got quite a bite, dog.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All the more satisfying to crush.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps inspired by the experience, her subsequent training was infused with far more power than usual.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! A-Are you sure?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I don't recall giving you permission.
...Well, you're free to tag along on your own if you wish.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I lost~~!!
One more round, please!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
I'll crush you as many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They continued to compete until Vodka was satisfied... making it a truly fruitful training session.
